content:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — keystore rollout for SOC2/ISO evidence pipeline. Need clarity on staging cutover owner, audit-log forwarding, and HSM attestation test plan. TL;DR: who can take staging cutover + open PR for audit config?

Maria Gonzales: I'll take staging cutover. Plan: do config flip in staging -> smoke tests -> enable forwarder. Need eng-infra to confirm VPC route and firewall rules. @Priya Reddy can you confirm?

Priya Reddy: Priya Reddy: Can confirm VPC peering and firewall. Two network items: allow 10.12.0.0/16 -> 10.32.0.0/16 on port 443, and NAT gateway updates for outgoing to HSM cluster. Will finish by EOD Wed.

Jordan Lee: Jordan Lee: On audit-log forwarding, I have a small parser change to add keystore_id field. Will open PR today: https://git.redwood.com/r/audit/forwarder/pulls/128. @Maria please review.

Maria Gonzales: Maria Gonzales: Copy — will review. Also want to validate retention windows: staging 90d, prod 13mo? Confirming with compliance.

security-bot: security-bot: Reminder: evidence collected for HSM attestation must include signed certs + timestamped logs. See ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hsm-attestation

Sam Patel: Sam Patel: For attestation test plan — I propose automated ingest: run attestation job -> capture logs -> run verifier -> produce artifact. We'll need a sample manifest. I'll draft the manifest and attach to PR.

Alex Kim: Alex Kim: Sample config snippet for forwarder (staging):
```json
{
  "forwarder": "keystore",
  "retention_days": 90,
  "include_fields": ["keystore_id","event","timestamp"]
}
```

Jordan Lee: Jordan Lee: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/audit/forwarder/pulls/129 — includes field + tests. Assigning to @Maria and @Sam. :thumbsup:

Maria Gonzales: Maria Gonzales: Reviewing now. ETA EOD today for code review. If all good, schedule staging flip Thu 02:00 UTC.

Alex Kim: Alex Kim: Thanks. I'll update project board, create checklist in GH issues, and add 'auditor-notify' step. @security-bot can you queue pre-attestation checklist?

security-bot: security-bot: Pre-attestation checklist queued. Next: ensure KMS roles documented and evidence bucket ACLs set. Ping when staging flip scheduled.

Priya Reddy: Priya Reddy: Network tasks scheduled and queued in infra sprint. I'll post updates in #eng-infra and tag here.

Alex Kim: Alex Kim: Perfect — action items: Maria (staging cutover + review), Jordan (PR/tests), Priya (network), Sam (attestation manifest), security-bot (checklist). I'll close thread once PR merged. :white_check_mark:
